transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… it’s mostly elevators. I know they’re probably not actually dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I get really scared I’m going to get trapped. I just can’t seem to make myself feel normal about it.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel an intense fear or discomfort that reaches a peak within minutes?
Yeah… pretty much right away. Like when the elevator doors start closing, my chest tightens up, my hands get sweaty, and I just think, I need to get out. Even if it’s only a few floors.
Do you experience this kind of fear in situations other than being in elevators?
Not really… it’s mainly elevators. I know they’re not actually dangerous, but once I’m in there I just get scared I’m going to be trapped.
Do you avoid taking elevators when possible?
Yeah. Most days I’ll take the stairs, at home or on a job site. If there’s no other way… I’ll either try to get put somewhere else, or I’ll only ride if someone I trust is right there with me.
Is your fear of elevators mostly about being trapped, or is it also about other things like heights, enclosed spaces, or something else?
Mostly being trapped. I mean… I know elevators aren’t really dangerous, but once I have to get in one, it’s like I can’t shake that feeling I’ll get stuck in there.
Do you ever have these intense fear episodes when you're not in an elevator?
No… not really. It’s when I’m in one, or right when the doors start closing. Then my chest tightens up, my hands get sweaty, and I just think, I need to get out. Even if it’s just a few floors.
Have you ever had an episode of intense fear or discomfort like the ones you described in the elevator, but at other times when you weren't in an elevator?
No… I mean, not like that. It’s really when the elevator doors start closing. My chest gets tight, my hands sweat, and I just think I need to get out, even if it’s only a few floors.
Is there anything about elevators themselves that you're afraid of, beyond just the fear of being trapped?
Not really… it’s just that feeling I’m going to be stuck in there. I know it’s probably not dangerous, but I can’t make myself feel normal once I have to get in.
Is your fear only about being in an elevator, or does the fear of being trapped occur to you in other situations where you're not actually in an elevator?
It’s mostly just elevators. I mean… I know they’re not really dangerous, but once I have to get in one, I get scared I’m going to be trapped and I can’t really calm myself down.
Have you ever had an episode of intense fear or discomfort that was not related to being in an elevator?
No… I don’t think so. Not really outside of that.
Have you ever had an episode of intense fear or discomfort that was not triggered by an elevator or the thought of being in an elevator?
No… I don’t think so. It’s really only when it’s about the elevator, or thinking I might have to get in one.
Have you ever had an episode of intense fear or discomfort that was not related to elevators or being trapped?
Not that I can think of… no. It’s pretty much just the elevator thing.
Have you ever had an episode of intense fear or discomfort that was not related to elevators or the thought of being trapped?
No… I can’t really think of anything like that. It’s just been tied to elevators, as far as I know.
Do you feel anxious or fearful in social situations or when you're expected to perform in front of others?
Not really… I mean, I don’t love being put on the spot, but I wouldn’t say I’m scared of social stuff.
Do you feel anxious or fearful when you're in other confined or small spaces, like cars or tunnels?
Not really… cars are fine, and tunnels don’t really bother me that I’ve noticed. It’s more just elevators.
Do you feel anxious or fearful when you're in other enclosed spaces, like small rooms?
Small rooms? No, I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed that bothering me.
Is there anything else that triggers this kind of fear or anxiety for you, besides elevators?
No… not really. It’s mainly elevators. I know they’re probably safe, but when I have to get in one, I just get this fear I’m going to be trapped in there. I can’t really talk myself out of it.
Is there anything else, no matter how small it seems, that triggers a fear of being trapped for you?
I don’t think so… it’s really just elevators. I know they’re not actually that dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I get scared I’ll be trapped and I can’t really shake it.
Is your fear of being trapped ever triggered by something other than an elevator?

No… not that I can think of. It’s really elevators. I know they’re not really dangerous, but once I’m supposed to get in one, I just get scared I’ll be trapped, and I can’t make myself feel normal about it.
